nativeFacts.text:
I'll start by surveying the workspace: the commit, module layout, prior conformance runs, and where the schema and core protocol code live.I've mapped the roster and module layout. Now reading the core SDK sources that most constraints hinge on: the JSON-RPC session layer, client gating, agent dispatch, and the schema types.I'm reading the schema records that the structural constraints are judged on, and fetching the transport, agent builder and client builder evidence in parallel.ACP-V1-OVERVIEW-ABSOLUTE-PATHS: FAIL - the SDK transmits every path (cwd, additionalDirectories, fs paths, tool-call locations) exactly as the application supplies it and checks absoluteness nowhere (no `isAbsolute` in any `*/src/main`; `AcpAsyncClient.newSession` only null-checks the request at acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/client/AcpAsyncClient.java:366-372; `DefaultPromptContext.readFile` forwards the path at acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/agent/DefaultPromptContext.java:150-153), so a relative path reaches the wire unrefused.
ACP-V1-INIT-CLIENT-INITIALIZE-FIRST: PASS - `initialize()` sends `LATEST_PROTOCOL_VERSION` with the builder's capabilities (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/client/AcpAsyncClient.java:245-266) and every other ACP call fails with IllegalStateException until the agent has answered it (`afterInitialize`, AcpAsyncClient.java:801-812; ClientCallGatingTest.aCallBeforeInitializeFailsWithoutSending at acp-core/src/test/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/client/ClientCallGatingTest.java:83).
ACP-V1-INIT-IMPLEMENTATION-INFO: PASS - both sides model and send the field: `clientInfo` on the client builder (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/client/AcpClient.java:304-306, sent at AcpAsyncClient.java:261-262), `agentInfo` on the agent builder (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/agent/AcpAgent.java:1251-1253, answered at DefaultInitialize.java:53-54), and the annotation layer derives `agentInfo` automatically (acp-agent-support/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/agent/support/AgentAdvertisement.java:265-278); the core builders omit it unless configured, which the SHOULD permits.
ACP-V1-INIT-AGENT-RESPONSE: PASS - the default initialize answer carries the negotiated protocol version and capabilities derived from the registered handlers (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/agent/DefaultInitialize.java:35-55), and `InitializeResponse.protocolVersion` is a required field (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/AcpSchema.java:729-733).
ACP-V1-INIT-VERSION-AGREEMENT: PASS - the agent answers the client's version when it speaks it and its latest otherwise (DefaultInitialize.java:58-61; AgentAdvertisement.java:303-306), and the client refuses to proceed on any version it does not speak by failing initialize and closing (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/client/AcpAsyncClient.java:270-277; ClientCapabilityConformanceTest.java:49-57).
ACP-V1-INIT-REQUEST-LATEST-VERSION: PASS - `initialize()` announces `AcpSchema.LATEST_PROTOCOL_VERSION` (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/client/AcpAsyncClient.java:245-247; constant at AcpSchema.java:178); the `initialize(int, Map)` overload is documented for version-negotiation testing only (AcpAsyncClient.java:249-260).
ACP-V1-INIT-AGENT-SAME-VERSION: PASS - `DefaultInitialize.negotiate` returns the requested version when it equals the supported one (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/agent/DefaultInitialize.java:58-61), likewise AgentAdvertisement.java:303-306.
ACP-V1-INIT-AGENT-LATEST-VERSION: PASS - for any other requested version (or null) the same `negotiate` answers `LATEST_PROTOCOL_VERSION` (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/agent/DefaultInitialize.java:58-61; acp-agent-support/.../AgentAdvertisement.java:303-306).
ACP-V1-INIT-CLIENT-UNSUPPORTED-VERSION: PASS - an initialize answer with a version other than 1 closes the connection and fails the call with `AcpVersionException` whose message names both versions (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/client/AcpAsyncClient.java:270-277; acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/error/AcpVersionException.java:235-238; verified by ClientCapabilityConformanceTest.java:49-57 including `transport.isConnected()` false).
ACP-V1-INIT-CAPABILITIES-OPTIONAL: PASS - every member of `ClientCapabilities` and `AgentCapabilities` is `@Nullable` (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/AcpSchema.java:3347-3352, 3745-3751) and `NegotiatedCapabilities.fromClient/fromAgent` accept a null object or any missing member (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/capabilities/NegotiatedCapabilities.java:148-151, 188-191).
ACP-V1-INIT-SUPPORT-ALL-COMBINATIONS: PASS - each capability is negotiated as an independent flag with no coupling between them (NegotiatedCapabilities.java:148-178, 188-225) and gating is per call (AcpAsyncClient.java:734-787; DefaultAcpAsyncAgent.java:373-384), so any combination of peer capabilities is served.
ACP-V1-INIT-OMITTED-UNSUPPORTED: PASS - every negotiated flag defaults to false and becomes true only on an explicit `true`/object (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/capabilities/NegotiatedCapabilities.java:148-225, 654-698); SessionCapabilitiesWireTest.onlyAnObjectFromThePeerCountsAsAdvertised and LogoutCapabilityTest.logoutIsOffUnlessAdvertised (acp-core/src/test/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/LogoutCapabilityTest.java:54-59) check it.
ACP-V1-INIT-CLIENT-SPECIFY-CAPABILITIES: PASS - the record models fs, terminal, session.configOptions.boolean, auth.terminal and elicitation (AcpSchema.java:3347-3352, 3563-3636, 3661-3663, 7515-7516, 3235) and the builder derives what it advertises from the registered handlers when none are set explicitly (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/client/AcpClient.java:703-726, 801-809); the exact values are the application's.
ACP-V1-INIT-AGENT-SPECIFY-CAPABILITIES: PASS - the default initialize derives loadSession, sessionCapabilities and auth.logout from the registered handlers (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/agent/DefaultInitialize.java:37-52) and the annotation layer adds promptCapabilities and mcpCapabilities (acp-agent-support/.../AgentAdvertisement.java:308-324); the core default omits prompt/mcp capabilities, which peers must read as unsupported.
ACP-V1-INIT-PROMPT-BASELINE: PASS - the agent's `PromptRequest.prompt` accepts every `ContentBlock` with no agent-side content gating (AcpSchema.java:1114-1116, 5312-5319), and the client lets text and resource_link blocks through without any capability (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/client/AcpAsyncClient.java:769-787; ClientCapabilityConformanceTest.textAndResourceLinksNeedNoPromptCapability at line 193).
ACP-V1-INIT-PROMPT-RICHER-MAY: PASS - `PromptCapabilities` carries audio, embeddedContext and image (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/AcpSchema.java:4227-4229) and the client honours them (AcpAsyncClient.java:775-786).
ACP-V1-INIT-SESSION-BASELINE: PASS - `build()` refuses an agent without a prompt handler and installs a default `session/new` handler (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/agent/AcpAgent.java:1604-1618), `session/cancel` is always handled by `signalCancel` (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/agent/DefaultAcpAsyncAgent.java:90-91, 206-214) and `session/update` is sent by `sendSessionUpdate` (DefaultAcpAsyncAgent.java:262-265).
ACP-V1-INIT-SESSION-OPTIONAL-MAY: PASS - optional handlers (load, list, close, delete, resume, fork, logout) are registered individually and advertised as capabilities only when present (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/agent/DefaultInitialize.java:37-52; AgentHandlers.java:183-200).
ACP-V1-AUTH-CLIENT-NO-LOGOUT-WITHOUT-CAPABILITY: PASS - `logout` runs `requireLogout` before sending (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/client/AcpAsyncClient.java:343-348; NegotiatedCapabilities.java:625-627), and `auth.logout` counts only when an object is present (NegotiatedCapabilities.java:221-222; LogoutCapabilityTest.java:45-59; ClientCallGatingTest.java:95-103).
ACP-V1-AUTH-CLIENT-NO-TERMINAL-METHOD-ID: PASS - `authenticate` fails with IllegalArgumentException, sending nothing, when the id names an `AuthMethodTerminal` from the initialize answer (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/client/AcpAsyncClient.java:316-330; ClientCapabilityConformanceTest.authenticateRefusesATerminalMethodWithoutSending at acp-core/src/test/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/ClientCapabilityConformanceTest.java:73-92).
ACP-V1-AUTH-AGENT-TERMINAL-LOGIN-ARGS: PASS - the SDK models and transmits the terminal method's `args` and `env` (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/AcpSchema.java:7470-7494; acp-agent-support/.../AgentAdvertisement.java:336-345); the arguments themselves are the agent program's.
ACP-V1-AUTH-CLIENT-AFTER-LOGOUT: PASS - an error answer on any active session, `-32000` included, fails the caller's Mono with `AcpError` carrying the code unchanged (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/OutboundMessages.java:146-160; `AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED` at AcpErrorCodes.java:89), so nothing is hidden from the application that must re-prompt.
ACP-V1-SETUP-INIT-BEFORE-SESSION: PASS - `newSession`, `loadSession` and `resumeSession` all go through `afterInitialize`, which fails before an initialize answer exists (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/client/AcpAsyncClient.java:366-372, 383-389, 463-471, 801-812).
ACP-V1-SETUP-NEW-SESSION-ID: PASS - `NewSessionResponse.sessionId` is required (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/AcpSchema.java:948-951) and the SDK's default `session/new` handler answers a random UUID (AcpSchema.java:986-988; AcpAgent.java:1613-1617); an application handler's id is the application's.
ACP-V1-SETUP-CLIENT-CHECK-LOADSESSION: PASS - `loadSession` checks `requireLoadSession` on the negotiated capabilities before sending (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/client/AcpAsyncClient.java:383-389; NegotiatedCapabilities.java:194, 489-491).
ACP-V1-SETUP-CLIENT-NO-LOAD-WITHOUT-CAPABILITY: PASS - without `loadSession: true` the call fails with `AcpCapabilityException("loadSession")` and no message leaves (ClientCallGatingTest.aCallTheAgentDidNotAdvertiseFailsWithoutSending at acp-core/src/test/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/client/ClientCallGatingTest.java:95-103 with the loadSession row at lines 61-63).
ACP-V1-SETUP-LOAD-REQUEST-CONTENTS: PASS - `LoadSessionRequest` requires sessionId, cwd and mcpServers as non-nullable components (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/AcpSchema.java:1021-1024) and `loadSession` sends that record (AcpAsyncClient.java:383-389).
ACP-V1-SETUP-LOAD-REPLAY: PASS - the load handler receives the `AcpAsyncAgent` and can call `sendSessionUpdate` before completing (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/agent/AgentHandlers.java:101-113; AcpAsyncAgent.java:97), the response is written only after the handler's Mono completes (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/AcpAgentSession.java:267-270), and the client hands replayed updates to its handlers before completing the load call (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/AcpClientSession.java:157-160; AcpAsyncClient.java:375-377).
ACP-V1-SETUP-LOAD-RESPOND-AFTER-REPLAY: PASS - the `session/load` answer is the handler's result mapped to a response once the handler completes (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/AcpAgentSession.java:267-270), so updates the handler awaited precede it on the single ordered outbound stream (StdioAcpAgentTransport.java:507-542).
ACP-V1-SETUP-CLIENT-CHECK-RESUME: PASS - `resumeSession` checks `requireResumeSession` first (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/client/AcpAsyncClient.java:463-471; NegotiatedCapabilities.java:200, 519-521).
ACP-V1-SETUP-CLIENT-NO-RESUME-WITHOUT-CAPABILITY: PASS - without `sessionCapabilities.resume` the call fails with `AcpCapabilityException("sessionCapabilities.resume")` unsent (ClientCallGatingTest.java:95-103, row at lines 69-70).
ACP-V1-SETUP-RESUME-REQUEST-CONTENTS: PASS - `ResumeSessionRequest` requires sessionId and cwd and carries mcpServers (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/AcpSchema.java:1525-1528, matching the schema's required set), sent by `resumeSession` (AcpAsyncClient.java:463-471).
ACP-V1-SETUP-RESUME-NO-REPLAY: PASS - the SDK sends no `session/update` on its own for `session/resume`; the handler's result is answered directly (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/AcpAgentSession.java:267-270), so replay could only come from the application's handler.
ACP-V1-SETUP-RESUME-RESPONSE-STATE-MAY: PASS - `ResumeSessionResponse` carries optional modes and configOptions (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/AcpSchema.java:1569-1571).
ACP-V1-SETUP-CLIENT-CHECK-CLOSE: PASS - `closeSession` checks `requireCloseSession` first (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/client/AcpAsyncClient.java:429-435; NegotiatedCapabilities.java:199, 509-511).
ACP-V1-SETUP-CLIENT-NO-CLOSE-WITHOUT-CAPABILITY: PASS - without `sessionCapabilities.close` the call fails with `AcpCapabilityException("sessionCapabilities.close")` unsent (ClientCallGatingTest.java:95-103, row at lines 65-66).
ACP-V1-SETUP-CLOSE-REQUEST: PASS - `CloseSessionRequest` requires sessionId (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/AcpSchema.java:1413-1414) and `closeSession` sends it as `session/close` (AcpAsyncClient.java:429-435).
ACP-V1-SETUP-CLOSE-CANCELS-AND-FREES: PASS - on `session/close` the agent session cancels the active prompt, delivers a synthetic `session/cancel` to the cancel handler and answers close only after the turn ended (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/AcpAgentSession.java:271-273, 286-297; SessionCloseCancelsPromptTest at acp-core/src/test/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/agent/SessionCloseCancelsPromptTest.java:52-91 asserts order "cancel s-1", "prompt answered", "close s-1"); freeing resources is the handler's.
ACP-V1-SETUP-CLOSE-MAY-ERROR: PASS - a close handler that fails with `AcpProtocolException` is answered with that error code, message and data (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/InboundMessages.java:220-223).
ACP-V1-SETUP-ADDITIONAL-DIRS-ABSOLUTE: FAIL - when the agent advertises the capability the client sends `additionalDirectories` exactly as given with no absoluteness check (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/client/AcpAsyncClient.java:734-740 checks only presence; no `isAbsolute` anywhere in `*/src/main`).
ACP-V1-SETUP-CLIENT-ADDITIONAL-DIRS-ONLY-WITH-CAPABILITY: PASS - a non-empty `additionalDirectories` adds `requireAdditionalDirectories` to new/load/resume/fork (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/client/AcpAsyncClient.java:370, 387, 468, 484, 734-740; ClientCallGatingTest.additionalDirectoriesAreNotSentToAnAgentThatDidNotAdvertiseThem at acp-core/src/test/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/client/ClientCallGatingTest.java:169-177).
ACP-V1-SETUP-CWD-ABSOLUTE: FAIL - `newSession`/`loadSession`/`resumeSession` send the application's `cwd` without checking that it is absolute (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/client/AcpAsyncClient.java:366-372, 383-389, 463-471; `NewSessionRequest.cwd` is an unchecked String at AcpSchema.java:895).
ACP-V1-SETUP-CWD-USED-REGARDLESS-OF-SPAWN: PASS - the SDK hands `cwd` to the session handler unchanged as a required field (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/AcpSchema.java:895; AcpTransport.unmarshalParams at AcpTransport.java:304-318) and performs no file-system work of its own that could depend on the process directory (no `Files.*` calls in acp-core/src/main); use of the directory is the application's.
ACP-V1-SETUP-CWD-RELATIVE-BASE: PASS - the SDK resolves no paths itself (no `Path`/`Files` resolution in acp-core/src/main; `DefaultPromptContext.readFile` forwards the path verbatim at acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/agent/DefaultPromptContext.java:150-153), so it cannot rebase relative paths away from `cwd`; resolution is the application's.
ACP-V1-SETUP-CWD-IN-ROOT-SET: PASS - `cwd` and `additionalDirectories` are delivered together on the request record (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/AcpSchema.java:895-898, 1021-1024, 1525-1528), so the application's root set necessarily starts from `cwd`.
ACP-V1-SETUP-ROOT-SET-BOUNDARY: PASS - the SDK exposes both inputs of the effective root set to the handler (`cwd`, `additionalDirectories` at acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/AcpSchema.java:895-898); tool operations are the application's.
ACP-V1-SETUP-CLIENT-MCP-SERVERS-MAY: PASS - `NewSessionRequest.mcpServers` is a list of `McpServer` with stdio, http and sse variants (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/AcpSchema.java:895-896, 7148-7268).
ACP-V1-SETUP-AGENT-MCP-STDIO: PASS - `McpServerStdio` is the default variant read without any `type` (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/AcpSchema.java:7148-7177), the client sends stdio servers to any agent without a capability check (AcpAsyncClient.java:747-762; ClientCapabilityConformanceTest.java:123-127) and the whole list reaches the agent handler.
ACP-V1-SETUP-AGENT-MCP-HTTP-SHOULD: PASS - the SDK models `McpServerHttp` and `mcpCapabilities.http` (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/AcpSchema.java:7207-7228, 4177-4178) and the annotation layer advertises it via `@AcpAgent(mcpHttp)` (acp-agent-support/.../AgentAdvertisement.java:241-242, 320); connecting is the application's.
ACP-V1-SETUP-CLIENT-CHECK-MCP-TRANSPORT: PASS - `withMcpServers` adds `requireMcpHttp`/`requireMcpSse` for each http/sse server on new/load/resume/fork (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/client/AcpAsyncClient.java:747-762; ClientCapabilityConformanceTest.httpAndSseMcpServersAreNotSentToAnAgentThatDidNotAdvertiseThem at acp-core/src/test/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/ClientCapabilityConformanceTest.java:108-129).
ACP-V1-SETUP-AGENT-CONNECT-ALL-MCP: PASS - the request record delivers the complete `mcpServers` list to the handler unfiltered (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/AcpSchema.java:895-896; AcpTransport.java:304-318; McpServerConfigurationTest.mixedMcpServersRoundTrip); connecting is the application's.
ACP-V1-SETUP-CLIENT-OWN-MCP-MAY: PASS - nothing in the client distinguishes a client-owned server; any `McpServer` entry is sent (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/client/AcpAsyncClient.java:366-372, 747-762).
ACP-V1-LIST-INIT-FIRST: PASS - `listSessions` goes through `afterInitialize` (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/client/AcpAsyncClient.java:414-420, 801-812).
ACP-V1-LIST-CLIENT-CHECK-CAPABILITY: PASS - `listSessions` requires `sessionCapabilities.list` before sending (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/client/AcpAsyncClient.java:417; NegotiatedCapabilities.java:198, 499-501).
ACP-V1-LIST-CLIENT-NO-LIST-WITHOUT-CAPABILITY: PASS - the call fails with `AcpCapabilityException("sessionCapabilities.list")` and nothing is sent (ClientCallGatingTest.java:95-103, row at lines 63-64).
ACP-V1-LIST-AGENT-RESPONSE: PASS - `ListSessionsResponse` requires `sessions` and carries optional `nextCursor` (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/AcpSchema.java:1377-1379), and a handler producing no result is answered with an error rather than nothing (InboundMessages.java:183-186).
ACP-V1-LIST-ADDITIONAL-DIRS-MAY: PASS - `SessionInfo.additionalDirectories` is an optional list (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/AcpSchema.java:4277-4280; AcpSchemaSerializationTest.sessionInfoWithAdditionalDirectoriesSerialization).
ACP-V1-LIST-CLIENT-NO-MERGE-ADDITIONAL-DIRS: PASS - the client deserializes `SessionInfo` as received and keeps no per-session state to merge with (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/client/AcpAsyncClient.java:414-420 returns the raw response).

ACP-V1-SCHEMA-ELICITATION-CREATE-SHAPE: PASS - the request requires message and mode with sessionId or requestId scope, requestedSchema for form and elicitationId/url for url, and the response's action is accept, decline or cancel (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/AcpSchema.java:2439-2481, 2511-2574, 2684-2688; ElicitationWireTest.specFormExampleParses/specUrlExampleParsesWithARequestScope/responsesFollowTheSchemasThreeActions).
ACP-V1-SCHEMA-ELICITATION-COMPLETE-SHAPE: PASS - `CompleteElicitationNotification` requires elicitationId and is sent as `elicitation/complete` (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/AcpSchema.java:2649-2650; DefaultAcpAsyncAgent.java:340-342; ElicitationWireTest.completeNotificationCarriesTheElicitationId).
ACP-V1-SCHEMA-CONTENT-BLOCK-VARIANTS: PASS - `ContentBlock` is discriminated by `type` over text, image, audio, resource_link and resource with the schema's required members, and `ToolCallContent` over content, diff (path, newText required) and terminal (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/AcpSchema.java:5312-5552, 6331-6490; AcpSchemaDiscriminatorTest; ForwardCompatibilityTest.knownVariantsWriteTheirDiscriminatorOnce at line 166).
ACP-V1-SCHEMA-STOP-REASON-VALUES: PASS - `StopReason` defines exactly end_turn, max_tokens, max_turn_requests, refusal and cancelled as its known values, and the SDK's own answers use those constants (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/AcpSchema.java:6551-6599; AcpAgentSession.java:312-314); unknown values are kept only on read for forward compatibility (EnumForwardCompatibilityTest.unknownStopReasonIsKeptAndKnownOnesAreTheConstants).
ACP-V1-SCHEMA-ERROR-OBJECT: PASS - `JSONRPCError` has int code, String message and optional data (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/AcpSchema.java:602-603) and `AcpErrorCodes` keeps -32700, -32600, -32601, -32602, -32603, -32800, -32000 and -32002 with their stable meanings (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/error/AcpErrorCodes.java:39-102).
ACP-V1-SCHEMA-MCP-SERVER-VARIANTS: PASS - stdio is the default variant without `type` (name, command, args, env), http and sse write `type` with name, url and headers (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/AcpSchema.java:7148-7268; WireFormatTest.mcpServersWriteTheirTransportTypeOnlyWhenTheSchemaHasOne at acp-core/src/test/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/WireFormatTest.java:96-100; McpServerConfigurationTest).
ACP-V1-SCHEMA-AUTH-METHOD-VARIANTS: PASS - `AuthMethodAgent` is the default (no or `agent` type) with id and name, `AuthMethodTerminal` writes `type: "terminal"` with optional args and env (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/AcpSchema.java:7371-7494; TerminalAuthTest.terminalMethodWritesItsTypeOnceAndAgentMethodNone).
ACP-V1-SCHEMA-EXTENSION-METHOD-NAMES: PASS - extension methods must start with `_` on every send and registration path and carry arbitrary params/results (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/ExtensionMethods.java:376-405; AgentHandlers.RAW_PARAMS at AgentHandlers.java:94; ExtensionMethodsTest.sendersRejectNamesWithoutUnderscore), and any other unknown method is answered `-32601` rather than routed (AcpAgentSession.java:233-237).
ACP-V1-JSONRPC-VERSION-MEMBER: PASS - every envelope is built with `JSONRPC_VERSION = "2.0"` and an inbound request or notification with any other `jsonrpc` is refused as Invalid Request (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/AcpSchema.java:171, 210-213, 520-531; OutboundMessages.java:110-111, 186).
ACP-V1-JSONRPC-RPC-PREFIX-RESERVED: PASS - no shipped method name begins with `rpc.` (constants at acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/AcpSchema.java:316-497) and custom methods are accepted only with a leading `_` (ExtensionMethods.java:399-405), so an `rpc.`-prefixed name cannot be registered or sent through the SDK's API.
ACP-V1-JSONRPC-PARAMS-MAY-BE-OMITTED: PASS - null params are omitted on the wire (`@JsonInclude(NON_NULL)` at acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/AcpSchema.java:519-521, 549-551) and an omitted params is delivered to handlers as an empty object (InboundMessages.paramsOrEmpty at InboundMessages.java:132-134; AcpClientSessionTest.requestWithoutParamsReachesItsHandlerAsAnEmptyObject).
ACP-V1-JSONRPC-ID-TYPE: PASS - an inbound id must be a String, Number or null and a message without `id` is read as a notification (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/AcpSchema.java:207-220, 241-250; AcpJsonRpcMessageTest.deserializeJsonRpcRequestWithStringId).
ACP-V1-JSONRPC-ID-NOT-NULL: PASS - the SDK generates every outbound request id as a non-null string (prefix plus counter) (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/OutboundMessages.java:53-55, 89).
ACP-V1-JSONRPC-ID-NO-FRACTION: PASS - generated ids are strings, never fractional numbers (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/OutboundMessages.java:89), and a received fractional id is kept as is for correlation rather than altered (InboundRequests.key at InboundRequests.java:499-507).
ACP-V1-JSONRPC-RESPONSE-SAME-ID: PASS - result and error responses copy `request.id()` and the id member is always written (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/InboundMessages.java:188-196; AcpSchema.java:580-581; WireFormatTest.responseEnvelopeWithEnumResult at line 58-63).
ACP-V1-JSONRPC-NO-REPLY-TO-NOTIFICATION: PASS - notifications are dispatched to a `Mono<Void>` path that never produces a response on either side (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/AcpAgentSession.java:215-218; AcpClientSession.java:250-259, 371-375; AcpAgentSessionLifecycleTest.responseToARequestOfTheAgentProducesNoReply).
ACP-V1-JSONRPC-PARAMS-STRUCTURED: PASS - every params value is a schema record or map serialized as a JSON object by name (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/AcpSchema.java:520-521 with `@JsonProperty`-named records; GoldenFileTest.serializeInitializeRequestMatchesExpectedStructure).
ACP-V1-JSONRPC-PARAM-NAMES-EXACT: PASS - every component is bound by an explicit camelCase `@JsonProperty` matching the schema (for example acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/AcpSchema.java:693-696, 895-898, 1114-1116) and the golden fixtures under acp-core/src/test/resources/golden parse against them (GoldenFileTest).
ACP-V1-JSONRPC-RESPONSE-REQUIRED: PASS - every tracked request is answered exactly once with the handler's result, an error, or `-32800`, including unknown methods (`-32601`), empty handler results (`-32603`), and requests pending when stdin ends (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/InboundRequests.java:343-365; InboundMessages.java:183-186; AcpAgentSession.java:233-237; StdioAcpAgentTransportTest.everyRequestReceivedBeforeTheInputEndsIsAnsweredBeforeTermination).
ACP-V1-JSONRPC-RESULT-ON-SUCCESS: PASS - a success response is built with the result and a null error that `NON_NULL` omits, and a null result is written as `{}` (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/InboundMessages.java:188-190; AcpSchema.java:579-583; WireFormatTest.responseEnvelopeWithAnEmptyResultWritesAnEmptyObject at line 67-72).
ACP-V1-JSONRPC-ERROR-MEMBER-ON-ERROR: PASS - an error response is built with a null result and a `JSONRPCError` object (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/InboundMessages.java:192-196, 211-238; AcpSchemaSerializationTest.jsonRpcErrorResponseSerialization).
ACP-V1-JSONRPC-RESPONSE-ID-ECHO: PASS - responses echo the request id, and for an unreadable line the id is null for a parse error and the readable id for an invalid request (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/AcpSchema.java:180-209; UnreadableMessageResponseTest at acp-core/src/test/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/UnreadableMessageResponseTest.java:28-82).
ACP-V1-JSONRPC-RESULT-XOR-ERROR: PASS - the two factory paths set exactly one of result or error and `NON_NULL` drops the other (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/InboundMessages.java:188-196; AcpSchema.java:579-583; WireFormatTest.java:58-72).
ACP-V1-JSONRPC-ERROR-CODE-INTEGER: PASS - `JSONRPCError.code` is a primitive `int` (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/AcpSchema.java:602).
ACP-V1-JSONRPC-ERROR-MESSAGE-CONCISE: PASS - the SDK's own error messages are short phrases ("Invalid params", "Internal error", "Request cancelled", "Method not found: x") with detail moved to `data` (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/AcpTransport.java:310-315; InboundMessages.java:122, 235-237; InboundRequests.java:289; AcpClientSession.java:342-363).
ACP-V1-JSONRPC-ERROR-RESPONSE-CONTAINS-ERROR: PASS - every failure path answers with a `JSONRPCError` carrying code and message (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/InboundMessages.java:211-238; JsonRpcErrorsOnTheWireTest at acp-core/src/test/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/agent/JsonRpcErrorsOnTheWireTest.java:59-104).
ACP-V1-SETUP-ADDITIONAL-DIRS-FULL-LIST-ON-LOAD: PASS - the client stores no roots and sends exactly the `additionalDirectories` the application puts on the load or resume request, omitting the field when none is given (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/AcpSchema.java:1023, 1527; AcpAsyncClient.java:383-389, 463-471), so an omitted or empty list can never restore stored roots implicitly.
ACP-V1-ELIC-CLIENT-UNADVERTISED-MODE-INVALID-PARAMS: PASS - a form or url request whose mode the client did not advertise is answered `-32602` without reaching the handler (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/client/AcpClient.java:836-848, 863-873; ElicitationTest.clientAnswersInvalidParamsForAModeItDidNotAdvertise at acp-core/src/test/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/integration/ElicitationTest.java:171-194).
OBSERVATION ACP-V1-ELIC-CLIENT-UNADVERTISED-MODE-INVALID-PARAMS: a client with no elicitation handler answers `elicitation/create` with `-32601` rather than `-32602` (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/AcpClientSession.java:319-327, 361-363), and before its initialize request every mode passes to the handler (AcpClient.java:864-866; ElicitationTest.java:247-262).
ACP-V1-MODES-SET-MODE-ID-LISTED: CANNOT_DETERMINE - the client keeps no record of `availableModes` and sends the application's `modeId` unchecked (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/client/AcpAsyncClient.java:398-404), so whether the id is listed is decided only by the application.
ACP-V1-CONFIG-SET-VALUE-VALID: PASS - the SDK's request factories enforce the type half (`bool` sends a Java boolean with `type: "boolean"`, `select` a String) (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/AcpSchema.java:1683-1698); membership of a select value in the option's list is left to the application, which the SDK does not check (AcpAsyncClient.java:499-506).
ACP-V1-EXT-UNKNOWN-METHOD-NOT-FOUND: PASS - an unrecognized request, custom or not, is answered `-32601 Method not found` on both sides (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/AcpAgentSession.java:233-237, 369-371; AcpClientSession.java:319-327, 361-363; ExtensionMethodsTest.java:221-247; AcpClientSessionLifecycleTest.unknownAgentRequestIsAnsweredWithMethodNotFoundNamingIt).
